clayresearch.delta: Treat effect-order topology and authority as separate semantic planes; no new core syntax is justified yet.

frank.delta: FRANK action->outcome->credit->reentry chains require compiler transformations to preserve authority decisions, transaction phases and causally relevant effect order, not merely returned values.

gwt.delta: No workspace equation change. Compiler/runtime must not reorder observable outcome/reentry effects in ways that alter causal-use traces.

emergenz.delta: Compiler effect reordering can confound intervention/replay evidence; bind compiler/lowering receipt and observable effect-order semantics in causal experiments.

claycode.delta: Add conservative effect transformation contract: resource/order domains, non-speculatability defaults, trace/partial-order validation and pass provenance. Add short-circuit regression probe. No syntax change.

hyperposition.delta: Independent/disjoint effect reordering is a partial-order/concurrency problem, not evidence for hyperposition or emergence.

claygraph.delta: Dynamic Run graphs may expose effect conflict/order edges as derived trace structure; topology remains non-authoritative.

unifieddb.delta: Reserve/commit/rollback and replay identity are observable effect phases; optimizer legality must preserve them and durable state.

harness.delta: Extend H-WP-10/H-WP-11 differential oracles with effect-erasure, duplication, conflict-reorder, disjoint-reorder and capability-denial mutants; exact trace first, conflict-partial-order only after validation.
